result.summary: No critical breakage found. The page is largely intact with 3 minor visual issues related to carousel clipping, inconsistent wishlist icon styling, and bottom card cut-off.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut mid-word and the '20-30 min' time badge is clipped at the right screen edge
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the horizontal carousel and apply proper text truncation with ellipsis so items are not cut mid-character

issues.description: Favorite heart icons under 'Popular right now' are inconsistent: the Ramen card shows a white outline with no background, while the pizza card shows a white icon inside a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite button style with a semi-transparent dark circular background to ensure visibility and consistency across all cards

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom with only the pizza image visible and no name, rating or delivery info, sitting flush against the bottom tab bar
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards are fully visible and not obscured when scrolling
